hypotheses.claim: The phrase 'SBIC, ChatGPT SBIC' refers to the Social Bias Inference Corpus benchmark rather than the Japanese SBIC investment company.
support: ACL 2020 primary paper explicitly defines SBIC as Social Bias Inference Corpus
Ziems et al. 2023 explicitly uses Social Bias Inference (SBIC) and reports 65.9% GPT-3.5 and 60.6% GPT-4 pairwise preference
counter_evidence: A 2023 secondary review mis-expands the acronym as COVID-19 social/behavioral implications
Japanese SBIC East Japan independently exists, but is unrelated to the benchmark
hypotheses.required_test: Retain both entity records and match future source context to exact acronym use.
